ground_truth.description: The refactor of test_release_probe_slot_called_on_runtime_error replaces the explicit `gate.detect_cap_hit = MagicMock(return_value=False)` with `_make_gate(...)`, but the new `_make_gate` factory does not set `detect_cap_hit`. As a bare MagicMock auto-attribute, `gate.detect_cap_hit(...)` now returns a truthy MagicMock instead of False, so any production branch that checks `detect_cap_hit` takes the opposite path (cap-hit detected), likely driving the escalation_created event and changing what the test actually exercises.

The `_make_gate` factory intentionally omits `detect_cap_hit` from its default attribute set, so it does not fully cover every UsageGate attribute a construction site may need; call sites that relied on `detect_cap_hit` returning a concrete False (rather than a truthy auto-mock) silently lose that behavior after routing through the factory.

TestMakeGateFactory pins account_count/active_account_name/soonest_resets_at/override passthrough but does not assert that the mock-driven branches (e.g. detect_cap_hit / cap-hit path) behave as the callers expect, so the contract test would not catch the missing detect_cap_hit default that changed runtime-error test behavior.

provenance.runs_db_query: SELECT task_id, project_id, outcome, review_cycles, verify_attempts FROM task_results WHERE review_cycles >= 1, cross-referenced with events (escalation_created, merge_finalized) -- see mining.mine_fn_candidates.
